rows.ja: より伝わりやすくなる
rows.line: 感情を持ってるかを伝えると、より伝わりやすくなるよ。
rows.en1: It gets across a lot better.
rows.en2: People actually get it.

rows.ja: 気持ちがだいぶ楽になった
rows.line: 話し合うときは、なんか気持ちがだいぶ楽になったなって。
rows.en1: It took a lot of the pressure off.
rows.en2: I feel way lighter about it.

rows.line: 一緒に過ごす時間の中で、やっぱ好きだなぁとか。
rows.en1: I'm still really into them.
rows.en2: Yeah, I really do love this person.

rows.line: そういう話のきっかけも貰えたかなって思います。
rows.en1: It got us talking about it.
rows.en2: It gave us an opening to bring it up.

rows.line: どちらかと言うと聞くみたいな関係性なのかなと。
rows.en1: more like
rows.en2: if anything

rows.line: 入ってみたら、何かメンバーとして参加してるような感じ。
rows.en1: Once I got in,
rows.en2: When I actually joined,

rows.ja: すごい素敵な〜だなって思いました
rows.line: すごい素敵なコミュニティだなって思いました。
rows.en1: I thought it was a really cool group.
rows.en2: Honestly, it's a great bunch of people.

rows.line: 結構最初躊躇してる方がすごく多くて。
rows.en1: A lot of people hold back at first.
rows.en2: Most people are kind of hesitant at first.

rows.ja: 何かできないかなと思いまして
rows.line: ちょっと何かできないかなと思いまして。
rows.en1: I figured I'd try to do something.
rows.en2: I wanted to help out somehow.

rows.line: 良かったらぜひお願いします。
rows.en1: Check it out if you're up for it.
rows.en2: Give it a shot if you want.

rows.line: すごい恐縮ながら、プランナーとして常駐させていただき。
rows.en1: I'm kind of humbled, honestly.
rows.en2: Not that I deserve it, but

rows.ja: 人には言えないような
rows.line: ちょっと人には言えないようなお悩みまで。
rows.en1: stuff you can't tell anybody
rows.en2: stuff you'd never say out loud

rows.line: そういう質問って、ツイッターでするのもアレだし。
rows.en1: Posting it on Twitter feels weird.
rows.en2: Twitter's not really the place for it.

rows.ja: いろんな意見聞きたい
rows.line: もっとこういろんな意見聞きたいし、みたいな時。
rows.en1: I want to hear what other people think.
rows.en2: I want more takes on it.

rows.line: 職場とかではなかなかしづらいというか。
rows.en1: It's kind of hard to bring up.
rows.en2: It's not something you just drop at work.

rows.ja: 本人は深刻に悩んでるんだけど
rows.line: ご本人は深刻に悩んでるんだけど、
rows.en1: It's eating them up, though.
rows.en2: They're really struggling with it, but

rows.line: ほっこりするお話ですね。
rows.en1: That's so sweet.
rows.en2: That's a feel-good story.

rows.ja: 意識しないとなかなか難しい
rows.line: 意識しないとなかなか難しいのかなと思うんで。
rows.en1: It won't happen unless you make a point of it.
rows.en2: You have to be intentional about it.

rows.line: いいやつじゃなくてもいいんですけど、
rows.en1: It doesn't have to be that.
rows.en2: Doesn't need to be anything fancy.

rows.line: 愛が冷める可能性もゼロではないよねって。
rows.en1: You never know.
rows.en2: It could happen.

rows.ja: 約束できることを約束しよう
rows.line: 約束できることを約束しようっていう話になった。
rows.en1: Let's only promise what we can actually keep.
rows.en2: Let's not promise stuff we can't back up.

rows.ja: 当たり前だと思わない
rows.line: 長年経っても、互いの存在を当たり前だと思わず。
rows.en1: Don't take each other for granted.
rows.en2: Never get used to having each other around.

rows.line: 2人が大事にしてるものって何だろうね、みたいな話。
rows.en1: What actually matters to us?
rows.en2: What are we really about?

rows.line: なるほど、絶好のチャンスだったんですね。
rows.en1: That was the perfect time for it.
rows.en2: Couldn't ask for a better shot.

rows.line: あの、いい発想だなって。
rows.en1: That's a great idea.
rows.en2: Smart way to look at it.

rows.line: 言葉を一から考える楽しみがまだまだある。
rows.en1: come up with it from scratch
rows.en2: start from nothing

rows.ja: めちゃくちゃ盛り上がりますよ
rows.line: めちゃくちゃ盛り上がりますよ。
rows.en1: It's going to be a blast.
rows.en2: You'll have so much fun with it.

rows.ja: めちゃくちゃオススメです
rows.line: 行動規範をつくるってのめちゃくちゃオススメです。
rows.en1: I highly recommend it.
rows.en2: Totally worth doing.

rows.line: ご飯を一緒に食べる、とかでも全然良いと思います。
rows.en1: That's totally fine.
rows.en2: That works just fine.

rows.line: 良い結婚式をされたのに、何があったんだろうなあと。
rows.en1: What happened there?
rows.en2: I wonder what went wrong.

rows.line: 後ろ姿を見てると、やっぱりここからだなって。
rows.en1: This is where it really starts.
rows.en2: Now the real thing begins.

rows.ja: それよりも大切なのって
rows.line: それよりも大切なのって、これからの二人の人生。
rows.en1: What matters more is
rows.en2: The bigger thing is

rows.ja: なんで〜してるんだろう
rows.line: なんで私たちはこの仕事してるんだろうとか。
rows.en1: Why are we even doing this?
rows.en2: What's the point of all this?

rows.line: 夫婦にもあったらいいんじゃないかなと思った。
rows.en1: Why not have one too?
rows.en2: It might be nice to have one.
